title: Make a minimal route
summary: ASP.NET Core: Make a minimal route. Change the greeting.
introduction: MapGet connects a GET path to a function. Open GET /. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Make a minimal route with ASP.NET Core

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n School, enter School, and replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. Stop the app before changing examples.

blocks.title: Make a minimal route

blocks.text: MapGet matches the root GET request. Its function returns the greeting string.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: MapGet only handles matching GET requests.
